notes: Modified cash basis city. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p5); per user ruling balances are fund balances (beginning 2,037,361, ending 2,245,911, p5); cash not filled (governmental cash printed as 'Cash and certificates of deposit' 2,146,792, county treasurer 4,588 and restricted 94,531, p3/p1). Statement 'Property and motor vehicle' 146,142 split using the General Department schedule (p15: property 114,501, motor vehicle 15,993, NPPD 5% 15,648). 'Intergovernmental' 410,124 split from the department/fund schedules (General p15 42,280 + Community Center grants 281,000 p17 + Fire mutual finance 14,321 p18 + Street highway 67,333 and motor vehicle fees 5,190 p21). 'Charges for services' 28,218 split from the schedules as in FY2024 (General 26,918 = Fire rentals 6,000 p18 + Park rentals 12,655 and hay sales 2,905 p19 + pool fees 5,358 p20; Cemetery grave openings 1,300 p24). 'Other receipts' 76,148 split from the fund schedules (General depts p15-20 64,918; Street 3,775 p21; Sales Tax 2,976 p23; Cemetery 2,896 p24; CDBG 1,583 p25). Business-type from the basic modified-cash proprietary statement (p8, Total column; ties to government-wide net position 1,222,071); business-type disbursements total = Statement of Activities business-type expenses 506,929 (p2); receipts = operating 520,200 + interest 945 (no single printed total); loan forgiveness proceeds 119,722 (capital contributions) in business_type.other_financing. The supplementary proprietary statements pp30-31 and individual fund statements pp33-35 are on a different (accrual) basis (net position 1,242,840) and differ from p8; detail for the utility funds uses the individual fund statements pp33-35. Detail: General Fund from the department schedules pp15-20 (the department combining schedule pp13-14 is not recorded, to avoid double counting); Street, Sales Tax, Cemetery, CDBG, CDA and Forestry from their own schedules (nonmajor combining p27 not recorded); ARPA Fund (p26) had no 2023 activity. The combined all-fund-types budget schedule (pp11-12) is not recorded since every fund has a more detailed schedule. Budget-only lines with no actual are skipped. Read pages 1-35 of 35
